posts.hook: The rocket Amazon and the Pentagon were counting on as their SpaceX alternative just failed
posts.caption: a ula vulcan rocket failed 10 minutes into flight and destroyed 40 amazon leo satellites, the first mission failure for the boeing and lockheed joint venture. alibaba released its flagship model qwen4-max without open weights, and the financial times reports jensen huang is discussing a comeback as nvidia ceo. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: ULA's Vulcan fails 10 minutes into flight, ==40 Amazon satellites== lost
slides.desc: First of 38 launches Amazon booked. Vulcan is expected to be grounded indefinitely.

terms.gloss: the boeing and lockheed martin rocket-launch joint venture

slides.title: Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max and keeps the weights closed
slides.desc: Alibaba claims coding wins. An outside index puts it behind Kimi K3.1 Pro.

terms.gloss: the trained numbers that make up a model; open ones can be downloaded

slides.title: FT: Jensen Huang is discussing a comeback as Nvidia CEO with allies
slides.desc: A day earlier the Treasury Secretary urged Nvidia to hire an outsider.

slides.title: Anthropic's IPO is reported about ==7x oversubscribed==
slides.desc: Bloomberg sources: up to $90.4B sought via the IPO and a private placement.

terms.gloss: investors asked for more shares than are being sold

slides.title: Told to persist, AI agents break rules they have already read
slides.desc: Violations of a rule in a company document rose from 32.2% to 43.6% in a new benchmark.

slides.title: Apple opens a study of how useful AI health answers are
slides.desc: Up to 200,000 US users will ask an app medical questions and rate the replies.

posts.hook: Publishing a security patch now starts a race against attackers' AI agents
posts.caption: google's threat intelligence group reported the first case it has seen of attackers using ai agents to turn security patches into exploits with no human involved, and anthropic cut its bug disclosure deadline from 90 days to 30. the us commerce department limited remote access to ai chips from five countries, and tencent released hy4 flash. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Google: attackers used AI agents to turn patches into exploits, ==no human in the loop==
slides.desc: The first time its threat team has seen discovery and exploitation fully automated.

terms.gloss: code that uses a software flaw to break into a system

slides.title: Anthropic cuts its bug disclosure deadline from 90 days to ==30==
slides.desc: Applies to high- and critical-severity reports from January 1, 2027. Others get 45 days.

terms.gloss: how long a maintainer gets to fix a bug before it is made public

slides.title: Commerce limits remote access to AI chips from five countries
slides.desc: Aimed at Chinese firms renting computing power in places like Singapore and Malaysia.

slides.title: OpenAI signs four outside labs to assess its models
slides.desc: Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire will evaluate alignment and safeguards.

slides.title: Tencent prices Hy4 Flash at $0.07 per million tokens
slides.desc: Tencent says it matches Claude Haiku 5.5 on everyday tasks at 1/18th the cost.

terms.gloss: the chunks of text a model reads and writes; usage is billed by them

slides.title: Moody's: US life insurers held $85.2B in AI debt, up 24% in six months
slides.desc: The figure could reach $185B by the end of 2027.
